name: _Open FM Record  ({Entity, Record} )
purpose: LedgerLink helper: for a QuickBooks entity record, looks up the FileMaker id of the record whose QBO id matches (ExecuteSQL on the configured field names), calls "_Open Sync Record" to open the sync record, focuses the QBO::Lock field and writes the FileMaker id into the entity's configured sync-key field. Leaves the record open and returns an error object.

by name: Config($Entity & ".fields.fmId") and Config.CurrentEntity("fields.qboId") (ExecuteSQL step 31)
QBO::Lock#33 (Go to Field step 40)
writes: by name: $syncIDFieldName = Config($Entity & ".fields.syncId") (Set Field By Name step 47, current record opened by step 33)

Step 29 uses $fmID and $qboID (different case from $fmId and $qboId, so empty/variable name case matters), and step 41 passes $addtionalErrorData (typo, never set). Config.CurrentEntity (step 31) is marked obsolete and reads QBO::selectedEntityName.

name: _Initialize
purpose: LedgerLink initialise: turns off user abort, turns on error capture, runs "Call Key Fields", goes to the "LedgerLink Processing..." layout (QBO) and opens the record to lock the sync record; on an error it goes back to the original layout. Returns the error.
open_question: Open Record/Request (step 11) locks the current QBO record: lock semantics must be reproduced by the target. Layout "LedgerLink Processing..." (QBO, id 32) is the context for later steps.

name: _Commit Record ({Entity, Record} )
purpose: LedgerLink commit: writes the QuickBooks id into the entity's configured QBO-id field, stamps the configured last-update field with the host timestamp when one is configured, clears the qbo_send flag, then commits the record without dialogs. If the commit fails it reverts the record. Returns the error object.
writes:
by name: $qboSendFieldName = 0 (Set Field By Name step 33, current record)
by name: $qboIDFieldName = $qboId (Set Field By Name step 37, current record)
by name: $qboLastUpdateFieldName = Get(CurrentHostTimestamp) (Set Field By Name step 46, current record; only if the field name is configured)
by name: $qboSendFieldName = 0 (Set Field By Name step 56, current record)
open_question: Step 33 writes qbo_send = 0 before the QBO id, and step 56 writes it again: the sets are redundant. $LL_IsUpdatingThisRecord (step 55) is a flag probably read by a trigger or calculation to keep a save handler from re-sending. Disabled steps 32 and 67-69 not listed. Config fields for each entity are in $$LL_API_Config, not in the DDR.

name: _Open Sync Record
purpose: Opens the single QBO sync record under a semaphore lock: goes to the "LedgerLink Processing..." layout, creates a session semaphore ($$QBO_Semaphor = UUID) if none, and opens the record by setting QBO::semaphor if the record is not open, the semaphores match, or the last commit is more than 2000 ms old; otherwise returns a "Sync record lock too soon" error. After a successful open it clears all key fields.
writes:
QBO::semaphor#34 (Set Field step 10, current record (QBO sync record))
QBO::semaphor#34 (Set Field step 14, current record (QBO sync record))
QBO::semaphor#34 (Set Field step 18, current record (QBO sync record))
open_question: Step 9-11 sets the semaphor and exits with Error(0) when Get(RecordOpenState) <> 0, without clearing key fields, which differs from the other success branches. The 2000 ms window is a magic number. QBO::lastCommitUTC#35 is a calculation field (read here).

purpose: Pushes one FileMaker record to QuickBooks Online: calls "Configure Sending Data From FM" (opens the record and builds the payload), sends it with "Send FMData To QBO", unwraps the Attachable response and any Fault, runs "_Update Line Records If Required" and "_Commit Record" to store the returned QBO id and clear the send flag. Reverts the open record and returns to the original layout on any error.

karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/449 "Configure Sending Data From FM {Entity; FmId }" (step 20)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/292 "Send FMData To QBO ({Entity , Data})" (step 40)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/301 "_Update Line Records If Required" (step 62)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/179 "_Commit Record ({Entity, Record} )" (step 68)
open_question: Step 22-29 nesting: when the config script reports "overridden" the script returns early (no send) with $data, otherwise continues; the semantic of "overridden" is set in script 449 (not in this share). The record is changed only through the called scripts 301 and 179; Revert Record/Request at steps 34, 51 and 72 discards open edits. The HTTP call itself is in script 292. Step 24 sets $error in the overridden+error case but the script then returns $error at step 79 only after returning to the original layout.

purpose: Opens the sync record under a lock for sending: returns an error if FmId is empty, opens the sync record via "_Open Sync Record", focuses QBO::Lock, writes FmId into the entity's configured sync-key field, and returns an error if the record found for that key does not carry that FmId.

Step 35 uses $qboID which is never set (only $qboIDFieldName). The sync-key relationship that opens the FM record is defined in the relationship graph, not here.
